requirements.title: Durable publisher state and request budget
Adult publisher and accurate audience review
Geographic coverage for every launch point
Bounded delivery of a global catalog
Bounded asset cache and persistence writes
Curated origin and independent operator marks

properties.statement:
Schedule selection SHALL admit all in-scope public launch countries, operators,
configurations and sites without a fixed sample whitelist. The publisher SHALL
resolve selected/upcoming references against the global catalog and source
supplements, preserving new or uncertain identities. Missing artwork SHALL NOT
remove an otherwise eligible launch. A provider omission SHALL NOT establish
retirement, cancellation or worldwide schedule completeness.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Previously unseen organization or site: literal expected retain all three IDs and keep launch eligible, with catalog gaps; counterexample must yield keep eligible with null point and generic art, never filter by sample IDs.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
The watch SHALL fetch its static HTTPS feed through Garmin Connect: hourly by
default, every fifteen minutes from two hours before a known launch until thirty
minutes after its unconfirmed target time. Unknown-time launches use hourly mode.
Intervals SHALL be configurable within platform/provider limits, including an
optional five-minute mode. Drawing/countdown ticks MUST NOT initiate network
requests. Delivery delay SHALL remain explicit.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Connected refresh: literal expected B becomes the accepted schedule without manual refresh or on-watch provider credentials; counterexample must yield A survives and time/countdown continue locally; no partial B or foreground request. Provider unavailable or rate limited: literal expected A content and per-record validation timestamps remain unchanged; counterexample must yield no provider call before600seconds and no retry-on-draw loop. Refresh window changes: literal expected enter15minute mode atT-7200 and return hourly after the bounded endpoint; counterexample must yield hourly outside the window and no inferred liftoff; boundary expectation records inclusivity explicitly. Fixed cadence oracle: T-7201=3600s; T-7200=900s; T+1800=900s; T+1801=3600s; unknown target=3600s. The near window is inclusive at both known endpoints.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
The default deployment SHALL use a scheduled GitHub Actions updater and public
GitHub Pages files for one family's watch, without an always-running backend,
AWS account, domain purchase or recurring LLM calls. Watches MUST NOT query the
provider directly by default. Public feed files MUST contain launch/catalog data
only; fitness values and personal identifiers SHALL remain on the watch.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Personal deployment: literal expected public HTTPS and actual FR165 receive both versions without AWS/provider secret/custom app; counterexample must yield setup reports the missing prerequisite and does not claim deployment from a green build.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
The updater SHALL use the same hourly/near-launch policy: normally one and near
launch four primary provider polls per hour. Scheduler wakeups MAY only check
whether a poll is due. A configured fast mode MUST stay within twelve steady
calls/hour; manual runs, retries and extra requests share the provider budget.
Publication SHALL be serialized. Failed/invalid updates MUST retain working data
and validation times. No LLM SHALL infer facts.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Provider failure or overlapping runs: literal expected one serialized owner;429 persists backoff and retains accepted content; counterexample must yield stale expected-base fails without publishing or consuming an unreserved provider request. Successful unchanged provider data: literal expected validation advances by3600, content revision and reschedule flag do not change; counterexample must yield no false validation advancement or reschedule from a download/build timestamp.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

properties.statement: Publisher-side bounded coherent feed construction only. The requirement also needs conjunctive LS05.P2 actual native consumer/cache validation; this producer edge alone cannot satisfy watch behavior.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Unsupported or inconsistent snapshot: literal expected A accepted with stable IDs and exact supplied coordinates/times; counterexample must yield reject each candidate and retain A including its accepted metadata.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

scenarios: Compressed schedule exceeds the decoded allowance
properties.statement: Publisher-side decoded UTF-8 ceiling and lossless feed construction only: at most8192bytes including dictionaries/metadata; compression cannot enlarge the allowance. Required identities, timestamps/precision, explicit absence and source freshness are preserved. Whole LS06 also requires conjunctive LS06.P2 native runtime-container/persisted-size qualification; publisher bytes alone cannot satisfy it.
properties.oracle: Independently authored literal8192/8193decoded-UTF-8 byte vectors, including nonASCII strings/dictionaries/metadata/nulls/precision/source-validation facts. Publisher accepts8192without semantic loss and rejects8193before publication even when compressed transfer fits. This oracle proves only the publisher edge; it provides no native object/RAM/serialized-storage evidence.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

properties.statement:
The system SHALL choose the earliest eligible upcoming launch from the accepted
provider schedule using stable launch identifiers. It SHALL exclude cancelled
or confirmed completed entries, preserve uncertain timing explicitly, and not
treat a locally elapsed timestamp as confirmation that a launch occurred.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Earlier launch added: literal expected B selected and its model/site/time/context move together; counterexample must yield C excluded; elapsed unconfirmed records are not marked completed from clock alone. Estimated time passes without confirmation: literal expected awaiting-update state with no negative countdown or liftoff claim; counterexample must yield remain unconfirmed and return to hourly policy; no invented completion.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

properties.statement:
The accepted launch record SHALL retain the supplied rocket configuration name,
launch company and actual source mission.type/category as concise purpose when available. These values
SHALL belong to the selected launch and SHALL preserve explicit absence rather
than reuse another launch's context or invent a mission task. Display must preserve explicit absence; full description or invented synonyms cannot substitute.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Context follows the selected launch: literal expected all context fields belong to B in one accepted state; counterexample must yield no carryover of SpaceX or communications into B. Provider omits mission details: literal expected preserve absence and display supported unavailable context; counterexample must yield normalize to explicit missing according to schema without manufacturing a task or borrowing previous text.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

properties.statement: Subtract current UTC from exact or validated nominal-minute target on each redraw and wake; display accumulating-hours HH:mm:ss, missing targets --:--:-- and zero 00:00:00 without claiming liftoff. Keep source precision unchanged.
properties.oracle: Literal exact and minute arithmetic, offline wake and timezone independence; unknown/date/window without target remain placeholders, and source precision remains separate.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
The system SHALL identify a reschedule when the accepted target time changes for
the same launch identifier, recalculate the countdown and retain a change flag
for that selected launch. An unchanged successful refresh SHALL not create or
clear the flag; selecting a different launch SHALL not inherit it.
properties.owner: tools/spacefox/schedule.py; tools/spacefox/wire.py; watchface/source/NativeFeed.mc; watchface/source/FeedScene.mc; watchface/source/ScheduleState.mc; watchface/source/SpaceFoxView.mc
properties.oracle: Literal current MIN target1794609900→1794611100 at clock1794551202 produces58698→59898 seconds (16:18:18→16:38:18), +1200 and same-ID flag. Unchanged validation cannot create or clear it. Withdrawal gives null remaining and --:--:--; next timed launch identity cannot inherit prior latch. Actual captured SEC merge additionally retains unchanged-exact-UTC metadata behavior. Provider precision and exact_utc=null remain intact for MIN. Native assertions execute production classes rather than a Python countdown model.

Actual selected verifier receipt required; physical/phone/provider/publication acceptance stays in existing tasks.

scenarios: Publisher stops but the file remains available
Previously tracked record is absent from a new provider result
Faster checking ends while data is stale
properties.statement:
The watch SHALL persist data and each record's provider-validation time. Freshness
MUST use source age, never download/build time. Default stale limits are three
hours normally and forty-five minutes near launch, configurable with publisher
cadence. Re-fetching old data or validating other records MUST NOT renew a record.
Once stale, that record SHALL remain stale until newer source validation arrives.
Cache SHALL survive restart; an empty cache SHALL show no schedule.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Freshness threshold reached: literal expected source age10800seconds is stale while content/reschedule remain; counterexample must yield not stale at10799; independent reschedule survives stale transition. Offline startup without a cache: literal expected current time and four chosen metric fields work; no launch or fake timestamp; counterexample must yield generic geometry cannot fabricate a launch/countdown or make a nonexistent cache stale. Publisher stops but the file remains available: literal expected age continues increasing and stale appears; counterexample must yield fresh HTTP/build cannot clear stale or overwrite source-validation history. Previously tracked record is absent from a new provider result: literal expected A retains own older validation and pending status; counterexample must yield never copy batch freshness to A or infer A cancelled/launched from omission. Faster checking ends while data is stale: literal expected hourly cadence resumes but stale latch stays set; counterexample must yield do not clear latch until strictly newer validation for A arrives.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
SpaceFox SHALL provide an MIT instruction for an agent to reproduce a personal
instance: fork/copy, enable Actions and Pages, configure a per-instance HTTPS
feed URL, validate publication and qualify the watch connection. The guide MUST
cover quota, delayed/disabled schedules, failure recovery and changing host URL.
Another user's setup MUST NOT require the author's credentials or hosted feed.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Another family configures a copy: literal expected their URL works through HTTPS and actual phone/watch without author key/feed; counterexample must yield derive actual owner URL; report missing enablement rather than silently using author feed.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Runner disappears after a provider call
properties.statement:
The publisher SHALL keep versioned active/pending snapshots, source-validation
times, reschedule state, monotonic generation and request reservations/backoff in
a dedicated durable feed-state Git branch. Pages/CDN, Actions cache and expiring
artifacts SHALL NOT be sole recovery authorities. Requests SHALL reserve quota
durably before calling the provider; uncertain consumed reservations SHALL remain
counted after a crash.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Runner disappears after a provider call: literal expected reservation remains counted; accepted validation and flags survive restart; counterexample must yield recover authoritative Git ledger, not reset quota from CDN or ephemeral workspace. Prior state cannot be recovered: literal expected stop publication and retain deployed A with an actionable state error; counterexample must yield do not bootstrap anew, erase retained flags or fabricate consumed request history.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

scenarios: Fresh schedule artifact omits an unchanged image
properties.statement:
All schedule/catalog/manual deployments SHALL share serialization and use an
expected-base state check. A validated pending generation SHALL persist before
deployment; promotion SHALL require exact revision readback. Recovery SHALL
reconcile interrupted publication before a new one. Older queued code/state SHALL
NOT overwrite newer accepted generations, and deployment SHALL include the complete
referenced current/retained compatible files.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Crash between deployment and promotion: literal expected restart reconciles and promotes/retries exact8 before creating9; counterexample must yield reject old source/base; no live rollback or duplicate unreserved poll. Fresh schedule artifact omits an unchanged image: literal expected complete artifact contains D even when schedule is the only changed payload; counterexample must yield packaging fails before deployment; do not rely on additive retention by Pages.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

properties.statement:
The selected FR165 transport SHALL qualify oversized, deeply nested, malformed
and excessive-cardinality responses against actual platform parse/memory limits.
If Garmin parses JSON before the app callback, a callback check SHALL NOT be
claimed as a pre-parse size guard. Platform failures and rejected candidates
SHALL retain durable accepted data; transfer and parsed-object peaks SHALL be
measured separately.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Response exceeds native parser capacity: literal expected valid corpus fits measured peak and accepted cache can reopen; counterexample must yield accepted durable data survives error and reboot; callback guard is not credited as preparse allocation prevention.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: A newer SDK offers an unavailable API
properties.statement:
Native releases SHALL pin source, SDK, device profiles, dependencies and build
settings. The manifest SHALL declare watchface type, a stable application UUID,
only qualified products/languages and the minimum required API. FR165 baseline
SHALL fit its checked API 5.2 support without API 6-only dependencies. SDK version
SHALL NOT be treated as device runtime support.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. A newer SDK offers an unavailable API: literal expected device build succeeds with recorded SDK/profile/source/package identity; counterexample must yield build/compatibility qualification rejects it or supported path is chosen, not desktop-SDK-version proof.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
Official releases SHALL use the same backed-up 4096-bit RSA developer signing key
and application UUID for updates. The private key SHALL remain outside source,
Pages and data workflows. Release provenance SHALL record source/toolchain,
package digest, version, supported products/languages and test evidence without
publishing credentials. A forked native product SHALL use its own identity/key.
properties.oracle: Actual production RSA4096 encrypted PKCS8 restore and independently verified challenge signatures; SDK IQ/PRG cryptographic verification for two committed candidate source versions with literal production UUID and SPKI. Wrong password, corrupt/swapped backup, missing/substituted key and nonincreasing version must refuse without replacement or distributable output.
properties.planning_status: Implemented local production custody/restore and SDK candidate identity/update contract; actual observations and fresh independent/root judgment pending. Full task7.1 physical/Store and final-native gates stay open.

scenarios: Audience review identifies an applicable restriction
properties.statement:
The official publisher SHALL be the adult owner using their own Garmin developer
account; the owner has confirmed adult status. Unknown viewer age alone SHALL NOT
block implementation. Release review SHALL distinguish the developer-account18+
condition from the under13 audience/use rule, without claiming adult publication
or private sideload overrides that rule. Private ages SHALL NOT enter public data.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Adult owner publishes the app: literal expected developer-age condition satisfied without child-age implementation gate; counterexample must yield release readiness rejects that unsupported approval claim without demanding new age evidence. Audience review identifies an applicable restriction: literal expected applicable issue is honestly resolved before release without relabeling intent; counterexample must yield checklist blocks unsupported exemption while preserving private ages and truthful audience facts.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Pilot works in the simulator only
properties.statement:
After native checks and applicable platform review, the pilot SHALL use a device-targeted
Build for Device PRG and a verified GARMIN/APPS installation route. Real FR165
time/settings, active/AOD, health, phone sync, reboot and two data/asset revisions
SHALL be observed. Sideload success SHALL NOT establish Store approval or Store
settings/update behavior.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Pilot works in the simulator only: literal expected hardware acceptance stays incomplete; counterexample must yield receipt/provenance review rejects substitution; no Store or hardware-ready claim.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Package is uploaded but awaiting review
Another family uses the official app
properties.statement:
The official app SHALL be free without paid fields or activation. Store submission
SHALL export a tested IQ package for qualified products/languages, provide accurate
screenshots, dependencies, setup, permissions, privacy, rights and support details,
and pass Garmin review. Source publication SHALL NOT imply Store availability.
The actual approved Store installation SHALL be qualified before release closure.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Package is uploaded but awaiting review: literal expected release reported pending and official free listing not claimed publicly available; counterexample must yield public availability remains unconfirmed until approved Store install is observed. Another family uses the official app: literal expected second owner installs/configures without SDK or author key/hosting; counterexample must yield time/settings/owner feed still usable; any real prerequisite absence is reported.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Replace art without changing the renderer
properties.statement:
Monkey C logic, permissions, bundled fonts and new renderer/schema capabilities
SHALL update through a signed native release. Supported schedule, catalog, geometry
and frame content SHALL update from static HTTPS files. Code version, wire schema,
renderer schema, catalog revision, asset digest, publisher generation and per-record
source validation SHALL remain distinct; content builds SHALL NOT renew source age.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Replace art without changing the renderer: literal expected content changes without new app binary and source-validation age unchanged; counterexample must yield reject unsupported content and require native release; old compatible asset stays available.

scenarios: Unsupported input reaches the current app
properties.statement: Preserve settings and accepted cache through same-current-format update/reopen; refuse unsupported schema while retaining valid current data, honest source age and host namespaces. No compatibility feeds or legacy migrations.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Unsupported input reaches the current app: literal expected read supported projection or old cache with honest age, preserving settings; counterexample must yield keep accepted cache/settings, expose settings update reason and never fake fresh data. Change the personal feed host: literal expected launch/age/flags isolated while identical verified asset digest can reuse; counterexample must yield no state merge or inherited reschedule/freshness across hosts. Current-format evidence must use actual corpus records/UI; retained earlier-format receipts do not prove this revision.

scenarios: A newly deployed asset is defective
A signed app release is defective
properties.statement:
Code repair SHALL use a higher-version compatible signed release, without assuming
Store downgrade support. Asset rollback SHALL publish a new monotonic generation
pinning a prior compatible set. Schedule correction SHALL retain source provenance
and SHALL NOT fake newer validation or regress accepted source state. Each release
SHALL retain reconstructible source and manifest evidence.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. A newly deployed asset is defective: literal expected generation9 pinsD1 with unchanged launch-source validation; counterexample must yield reject regression/fake validation; rollback is new monotonic content publication. A signed app release is defective: literal expected higher-version compatible release preserves supported user settings; counterexample must yield release plan rejects unsupported downgrade/migration promise and records measured path.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: A launch outside the sample countries
A scientific rocket missing from the main provider
properties.statement:
The catalog SHALL cover all publicly documented Earth space-launch countries,
territories, current configurations, launch organizations and sites, including
orbital attempts and public civil suborbital/scientific flights. Geography or
the initial sample pack SHALL NOT limit admission. Non-public events SHALL remain
unknown. Scope, source dates and unresolved external omissions SHALL be reported;
provider enumeration alone SHALL NOT prove worldwide completeness.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. A launch outside the sample countries: literal expected all typed identities admitted with visual/coordinate gaps explicit; counterexample must yield metadata eligibility retained; missing art never becomes country whitelist. A scientific rocket missing from the main provider: literal expected supplement record retains distinct source/provenance/current review date; counterexample must yield reject false provider provenance and retain unresolved gap rather than invent provider coverage.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Inactive configuration has a future flight
properties.statement: The current product set includes configurations operating or in development in 2026 and later and officially planned future programmes, with evidence and uncertainty. Provider flags and pending counts alone do not establish status. Retain historical identities; preserve unknown future references and distinguish exact variants.
properties.oracle: Literal current/inactive and pending/review examples; source-backed exact IDs and variant labels. An inactive flag must not drop a future launch and a pending count must not by itself prove current lifecycle.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
The catalog SHALL distinguish launch-site country/territory, launch operator,
vehicle manufacturer and curated vehicle/operator origin. Organizations MAY be
commercial, governmental or multinational. Countries, territories, regions and
historical/unknown records SHALL retain their kind and source IDs. A manufacturer's
country SHALL NOT automatically become vehicle origin or launch country.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Vehicle launches abroad: literal expected pad country/point, operator mark and selected origin remain independent; counterexample must yield reject wrong role/mapping and omit unknown origin rather than infer. Government or multinational operator: literal expected eligible typed organization without guessed single nationality/commercial-only restriction; counterexample must yield coverage/role checks fail rather than dropping valid public launch identity.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology; origin-whole finite source cases implement only dated provenance, retention and selected-closure conjuncts. Original whole role/display/native obligations remain open.

scenarios: Only the first result page was imported
Known data gap is hidden by a fallback
properties.statement:
Each coverage claim SHALL bind dated source queries/pages, counts, unique IDs,
relations, curated supplements and catalog/asset digests. Pagination SHALL finish
without missing or duplicate IDs; count drift SHALL be reconciled. Separate
metrics SHALL report metadata, specific visuals, marks, sourced coordinates and
qualified geographic views. Truncated pages, provider flags, generic fallbacks
or explicit unknowns SHALL NOT be reported as full specific-visual coverage.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Only the first result page was imported: literal expected three unique IDs and pages reconcile before completeness claim; counterexample must yield import completeness fails and accepted complete revision remains. Known data gap is hidden by a fallback: literal expected visual/coordinate denominators show both gaps separately; counterexample must yield reject false full-coverage claim while runtime fallback remains safe.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Mark would identify a different organization
properties.statement:
All required non-placeholder configurations SHALL have a matching original or
redistributable specific visual, or a reviewed shared-geometry mapping that
preserves the exact model label. Required known operators and verified origin
countries/regions SHALL have identifiable licensed marks. Unknown identity SHALL
omit its mark. Generic or unverified art SHALL remain a reported gap, never a
substitute for completing the known-model artwork acceptance gate.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Newly catalogued model lacks artwork: literal expected runtime fallback usable but artwork acceptance incomplete; counterexample must yield full pack gate remains failing with explicitM gap. Mark would identify a different organization: literal expected O label retained and missing operator mark stays explicit; counterexample must yield reject incorrect association; never showM as operatorO.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Site is referenced despite its lifecycle flag
properties.statement:
Every required site SHALL retain its pad-level identity and sourced coordinates
or an explicit unavailable state. Full-screen flat map SHALL work
worldwide, including small islands, polar regions, the date line, sea/air launches
and foreign-operated pads. Shared world geometry or qualified regional detail
SHALL serve the point; missing country artwork SHALL NOT suppress a valid point.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Small island or date-line site: literal expected pin/context aligned and inside chosen fullflat map at target390; counterexample must yield native geographic qualification rejects clipping/missing necessary detail without shifting point. Moving or unavailable departure point: literal expected show supplied text and omit launch pin; counterexample must yield reject fabricated coordinate; actual sourced0,0 must remain a distinct valid fact if supplied. Site is referenced despite its lifecycle flag: literal expected pad ID retained in required set with uncertainty; counterexample must yield coverage gate fails instead of inventing position or discarding launch.
properties.planning_status: Cutover changed native/source/settings owner; prior receipts are historical pending current revalidation.

scenarios: Catalog refresh competes with launch updates
properties.statement:
The publisher SHALL maintain the complete catalog outside the watch and deliver
only the qualified bounded selection of metadata and immutable asset/map shards
needed by the face. Full-catalog refreshes SHALL share the provider-call budget
with schedule updates and support cached/resumable pagination. Global coverage
SHALL NOT require loading every model, organization, pad or high-resolution world
layer into watch RAM or enlarging the bounded schedule without qualification.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Full catalog exceeds watch limits: literal expected bounded feed/slice contains only necessary closure and verified shards; counterexample must yield watch payload/cache do not grow with global cardinality or fetch global manifest. Catalog refresh competes with launch updates: literal expected resumable catalog honors remaining shared budget without starving due checks; counterexample must yield only durable reserved request proceeds, no source-age renewal from catalog traversal.
properties.planning_status: Current-only witnesses remain planned after executed fixture/harness closure retirement. Retained historical observations do not execute this graph or close product acceptance.

properties.statement:
Country, organization, configuration, site and asset records SHALL be stored once
per typed stable identity and referenced by ID. Derived wire/storage dictionaries
SHALL be deterministic, versioned and lossless for accepted facts. Reordering or
pooling SHALL NOT change IDs, null/zero distinctions, strings, units or precision.
Aliases, provenance and full source detail MAY stay publisher-side; the watch
SHALL receive only its bounded required dependency closure.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Several launches share entities: literal expected one definition/content instance per acceptedversion with references; counterexample must yield retain typed/revision distinction; no accidental cross-kind or cross-version alias. Dictionary order or schema changes: literal expected decoded facts and references unchanged; counterexample must yield reject candidate with current cache intact; never use array order as identity.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology
properties.completion_note: Conjunctive with VC08.P2. This existing whole-contract/consumer property remains planned until supported wire decoding, bounded native dependency closure and accepted-cache preservation are implemented and qualified. Producer-only P2 cannot close VC08.

scenarios: Cache is full during an asset replacement
Unchanged launch gains a new source validation
properties.statement:
On-watch cache SHALL have explicit byte/entry limits and retention rules. Verified
immutable content SHALL be reused by digest; unreferenced entries SHALL be evicted
without deleting active or required recovery content. Update staging and rollback
SHALL fit the measured budget. Redraw/countdown ticks SHALL NOT initiate storage
I/O or rebuild/parse catalogs; new accepted source-validation metadata SHALL
still persist even when launch content is unchanged.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Cache is full during an asset replacement: literal expected evict only unreferenced content or deferB within measured peak; counterexample must yield defer rather than delete working/recovery content or exceed bytes. Unchanged launch gains a new source validation: literal expected new small validation state durable across reopen; immutableasset not rewritten; counterexample must yield durable active revision/age not advanced; redraw does not try writes.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Global catalog grows outside the selected slice
properties.statement:
Qualification SHALL record compressed transfer bytes, decoded payload bytes,
parse/activation peak RAM, decoded graphics/frame RAM, serialized value size,
total persistent cache and staging/recovery peak. Each SHALL fit the target
device/API budget. Compressed size SHALL NOT stand in for decoded or peak memory.
Alternate columnar/binary/compressed encodings SHALL require supported SDK paths
and measured end-to-end benefit before adoption.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Compressed content expands beyond limits: literal expected qualified candidate fits each separate measured FR165 bound; counterexample must yield reject/split via supported versioned path; compressedsize never presented as peakRAM proof. Global catalog grows outside the selected slice: literal expected selectedmanifest/feed/cache bytes stable within documented bounds; counterexample must yield growthqualification fails and no global coverage is silently removed to pass.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
Maintainers SHALL be able to add a rocket/model mapping, replace its image or
animation frames, and add or correct a launch site through one documented,
versioned catalog workflow. These operations SHALL not require editing the
watch-face layout or a second hardcoded site/model list.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Add a rocket visual: literal expected validate/build new revision without layout edits or second lookup; counterexample must yield reject bad revision and preserve accepted pack/settings. Correct a launch-site point: literal expected stable siteID, new coordinate revision and projectedpin follow correction; counterexample must yield reject invalid/provenance mismatch; no identity churn or false source point.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

properties.statement:
Catalog entries SHALL carry stable identifiers, supported schema/version metadata
and source/attribution. Rocket entries SHALL identify model mappings and asset
versions; site entries SHALL identify country, place and latitude/longitude.
An unverified model match or missing coordinate SHALL remain explicit.
properties.oracle: Independent literal fixture values and prohibited outcomes, not implementation roundtrip equivalence. Unknown rocket configuration: literal expected genericfallback plus supplied name retained; counterexample must yield reject guessedmatch; no unrelated named model image. Invalid geographic entry: literal expected valid zero accepted and preserved as a realcoordinate; counterexample must yield rejectinvalid/version; unknowns remainnull rather than false0,0.
properties.planning_status: planned; no acceptance or implementation is inferred by this evidence topology

scenarios: Static deployment and CDN versions differ
